tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (hero, features, FAQ, closing CTA). Default ground for `fg`, `fg-2`, `link`.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Alternating section band (Why, More features, Plans) and footer. Switch between `bg` and `bg-2` to separate sections, always with a top `border` rule.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, plan tiers, FAQ items, the install-command chip and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inline code background, icon-button hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for section rules, header underline, card and input outlines. Decorative only; it does not meet 3:1, so never rely on it alone to mark a control.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface`, `surface-2` (14:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: leads, card descriptions, list items, footer links. 5.5:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: tier labels, `$` prompt, FAQ `+`, copyright, input placeholders. 4.5:1 or more on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes (dark 4.6:1+, light 4.7:1+).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: elbwalker blue. Primary button fill, check icons, highlight word in the H1, focus ring, announcement bar. Light theme: 2.4:1 on white — fine as a fill under `on-primary`, too faint for text or as the only marker (flagged, kept from source).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills (6.9:1). Never put white on `primary` (2.4:1) — the current walkeros.io buttons do; the relaunch fixes it.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows, mono step numbers; `info` and the light `focus` ring use it. 4.5:1 or more on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes (dark 6.0:1+, light 4.6:1+). Underline on hover only.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Soft primary halo: hero radial glow and the 4px ring around the highlighted plan.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: input, select, checkbox and switch outlines, the 1px edge of menus, popovers and dialogs, scrollbar thumbs, flow edges. 3:1 or more on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes; `border` stays decorative.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 3px offset, on every interactive element: `primary` in dark, `link` in light, where `primary` is 2.2:1. 3:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers. The layer above it is `surface` with a 1px `border-strong` edge, never a shadow.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions and invalid fields, always with an icon and a word. Text at 4.5:1 or more on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes. Kept apart from every event and step colour, `event-property` included.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill such as a destructive button (dark 8.6:1, light 6.5:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and healthy states, always with an icon and a word. Sits on the blue side of green, so it stays apart from `danger` with red-green colour blindness, and apart from every step and event colour. Text at 4.5:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and states that need attention, always with an icon and a word. Kept apart from `step-transformer` and `event-context`. Text at 4.5:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, always with an icon and a word. The `link` colour in both themes.
